gold.title: uploadBlob swallows and logs where the repo's storage functions wrap the failure in a StorageError naming the key
gold.description: readBlob and deleteBlob both catch and rethrow as new StorageError(`failed to <op> blob ${key}`, { cause }). uploadBlob instead console.warns a generic message and returns null. Match the idiom: throw new StorageError(`failed to upload blob ${key}`, { cause }).

candidate.title: Catch swallows and logs where every sibling wraps in StorageError
candidate.description: Catch block should wrap error in StorageError like sibling functions (read-blob.ts:7-8, delete-blob.ts:6-7), but instead swallows and returns null. Uses generic message 'upload failed' instead of specific message interpolating key. Catch parameter named 'err' instead of 'cause'. Return type's '| null' only covers the swallowed failure; once error is thrown instead, null represents genuine absence of etag.
